experiment: FINAL method confirmation and paired test
method: 6 partial-correlation ICA blocks (d15..d300) weighted by sqrt(edges) + 10% weight on the 6 full-correlation blocks, alpha=0.35 recalibration, correlation-kernel KRR with nested lambda
key_scientific_finding: Partial correlation, not resolution diversity, carries the signal. Six full-correlation ICA blocks at six resolutions add only +0.003 over the best single block; the partial-correlation blocks add +0.033. Mixing 10-20% of the full blocks on top of the partial ensemble gives a further +0.002.
honest_limits: comparison baseline is a faithful reimplementation of the F-BERT recipe, not their official code
their published 0.627 uses Schaefer-400, ours uses ICA
task-vs-rest on identical Schaefer-400 was NOT significant (p=0.52 at n=93)
